== Usage ==
Allows for linking to a Discord guild. For individual Discord channels please see {{tl|Discord channel}}.

== Getting Guild ID ==
To get the server ID for the first parameter, open Discord, go to Settings &rarr; Advanced and enable developer mode. Then, right-click on the server title and select "Copy ID" to get the guild ID.
